svg.aria-label: CHECK: Kind http sends GET to a URL. Kind tcp connects to host:port. One target per box. HOLD: A status changes only after a run of equal results. One lost check stays green. STREAM: Server-Sent Events: a snapshot first, then one event per change. A ping every 15 s
